parameters.name: BackhaulDownALID
parameters.description: The IEEE 1905 {{bibref|IEEE1905.1a}} Abstraction-Layer ID (ALID) of the EasyMesh Agent on the network that is downstream of this EasyMesh Agent and has backhaul to this EasyMesh Agent.

parameters.name: BackhaulDownMACAddress
parameters.description: MAC address of the EasyMesh Agent's interface that is downstream of this EasyMesh Agent and has backhaul to this EasyMesh Agent.

object.description: This object identifies EasyMesh Agents and their interfaces that are downstream of this EasyMesh Agent and have backhaul to this EasyMesh Agent.
